summary.headline: Near-term carry survives: September 17-20 floor/body, 22-28 moderate stress demand, 30-55 tail supply.
key_points: Headline +45.827M signed VIX delta is mostly created by a 7.2M September 17P/20P sale; ex-package delta falls to +8.827M.
September 22-28 calls are selectively bought while 30-40 calls are net sold.
October retains 24-25 moderate-stress demand financed by lower puts and capped by 35+ call sales.
November and December incremental flow is net short VIX; the post-19:30 tape contributes about -18.2M signed VIX delta.
summary.daily_note: Near-term SPX regime remains supportive while September VIX stays below 18-20. Acceptance above 20 activates the bought 22-25 -> 28 stress route; 29-31 and 35-40 are major monetization/supply zones.

leave_one_out.comment: Excluding the dominant September 17P/20P sale reduces signed VIX delta from +45.827M to +8.827M; the headline long-VIX-looking delta is mostly floor-building via put selling.

levels.label: 17-20 SEPTEMBER FLOOR / BODY
levels.interpretation: Largest cross-expiry premium concentration. September downside is heavily sold and central volatility is supplied; below this region the floor thesis weakens.

levels.label: 22-25 MODERATE STRESS DEMAND
levels.interpretation: Net call premium is bought in the working stress zone; this is the first meaningful convexity bucket if September VIX accepts above 18-20.

levels.label: 28-31 STRESS MONETIZATION
levels.interpretation: Calls are net sold across 28-31, creating the first large monetization/cap zone above moderate stress demand.

levels.label: 35-40 TAIL SUPPLY
levels.interpretation: Extreme call wing is net sold. Acceptance through this zone would invalidate the controlled-stress interpretation.

levels.label: 50-55 DISASTER TAIL SUPPLY
levels.interpretation: Far disaster wing is not receiving broad demand in this snapshot; visible flow is net sold.

notes: Far strikes are low-probability tail insurance and not price targets

structures.interpretation: Large September put sale builds a conditional 17-20 VIX floor / downside-risk-acceptance zone; it is not equivalent to outright call buying.
Likely September 22/35 call debit spread: moderate stress is bought while the extreme tail is monetized.
Short 16P appears to finance an October 25/35 call-spread-like stress hedge; moderate stress is retained, tail above 35 is sold.
November put demand at 19 combined with 30C supply expresses lower deferred VIX and monetizes a higher stress regime.
December 20P buy plus 30C sale is a directional lower-VIX package with upper stress monetization.
Late November flow partially restores positive VIX exposure, but does not overturn the session's net short-VIX deferred book.
